title: The bleak pulpit of saint Mark’s
html_source: The church (c. 1737) is on Mark Street, just off Great Brunswick (now Pearse) Street. Built in a neoclassical style so severe as to be bleak, the west front is typical: rugged and black, the sweeping curve of walls unrelieved by the slit windows that are intended to light the staircases within.
